descriptions.text: A warm, curiosity-led nursery in the Old School House on Hillingdon Road, Uxbridge.
Dedicated baby, toddler and preschool rooms, with learning planned around each child.
Book a tour to meet our educators, see the rooms and talk through your child's routines.
Arrange a visit today. Off-street parking at the rear, minutes from Uxbridge town centre.
